jobs_results.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
📢 Business Insights es una empresa de desarrollo de software personalizado para empresas. Estamos viviendo una etapa de crecimiento y queremos incorporar perfiles J2EE Senior para trabajar en un proyecto estable, retador tecnológicamente y con un gran equipo.

Creemos en la importancia de la innovación y la creatividad en la creación de soluciones informáticas personalizadas de alta calidad para nuestros clientes. Somos un equipo diverso de ingenieros altamente capacitados y apasionados por la tecnología, que trabajamos juntos para resolver desafíos complejos y mejorar continuamente nuestras habilidades.

Nos gustaría que formes parte de nuestro equipo de desarrollo de software, y estamos seguros de que tu experiencia y habilidades serán una valiosa para nuestra empresa. Te ofrecemos un ambiente de trabajo enriquecedor y colaborativo, donde tendrás la oportunidad de aprender y crecer como desarrollador/a de software mientras trabajas en proyectos interesantes y significativos.

No... solo eso, sino que también tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con clientes de renombre en diversas industrias, lo que te permitirá adquirir una amplia experiencia en el desarrollo de software y mejorar tus habilidades en la creación de soluciones innovadoras y efectivas.

Funciones y responsabilidades:
• + 3 años de experiencia como J2EE
• Spring MVC
• Conocimientos en HTML, Javascript
• Análisis de requisitos y diseño de soluciones
• Identificación de ambigüedades e inconsistencias en requisitos y diseño.
• Identificación de tareas asociadas a la construcción de los diseños
• Planes de prueba y acciones ligadas al aseguramiento de la calidad de la solución

Requisitos:
• Habilidades comunicativas y formativas
• Experiencia trabajando en proyectos ágiles / Scrum
• Capacidad de análisis y diseño de soluciones
• Background técnico Java / Web
• Inglés medio

Valorable:
• Thymeleaf
• Java Server Face

Conocimientos:
• Spring boot, Spring data, Hibernate, Microservicios REST
• Experiencia en integración con servicios y aplicaciones de terceros
• Experiencia en proyectos con Integración continua (Github, Jenkins , JIRA, Nexus)
• Haber trabajado en entornos de desarrollo agile y participado en el ciclo de vida completo del proyecto desde la definición de la arquitectura técnica de la solución hasta la implantación.
• Recomendable haber trabajado en proyectos de diseño e implantación BPMs
• Camunda, jBPM, Activity, Bonita, etc.
• Recomendable haber trabajado con proyectos de diseño e implantación de herramientas de decisión (BRMS) Corticon
• Recomendable haber participado en la definición / implantación de herramientas y/o procedimientos de trabajo dentro del ámbito de la integración continua.
• Conocimientos de sistemas : Linux , Servidores de aplicaciones( tomcat, jboss)
• Capacidad para trabajar dentro de un equipo multidisciplinar y heterogéneo

Modalidad Hibrida 4 días de teletrabajo a la semana

Envíanos tu CV, queremos conocerte

jobs_results.title: Arquitecto de software Senior
jobs_results.description:
Funciones

Responsabilidades:
• Realizar proyectos de optimización sistemas middleware a nivel arquitectura y configuración de la misma.
• Realizar estudios de costes y escalabilidad de entornos cloud.
• Realizar propuestas de mejoras de infraestructura para optimización de recursos y costes en entornos on
• premise y cloud.
• Gestionar el modelo de servicio con los clientes asignados.
• Controlar que el proceso de servicio es ejecutado de forma correcta por las personas a su cargo.
• Elaborar y actualizar la metodología de trabajo con orientación de mejora continua.
• Generación de documentación técnica.
• Resolver las dudas, consultas o problemas relacionados con la arquitectura técnica.
• Investigar y desarrollar nuevas utilidades en el área middleware.
• Incorporar nuevas líneas de negocio dentro del portafolio de la empresa.

Requisitos

Requerido:
• Más de 5 años de experiencia en el desarrollo aplicaciones empresariales.
• Conocimiento arquitectura software (para entornos cloud... y entornos híbridos). o Microservicios o Virtualización o Gestión de comunicaciones (SOA, API, Mensajería)
• Conocimiento arquitectura para entornos on
• premise
• Experiencia en proyectos tecnológicos para grandes empresas (ibex35).
• Capacidades de comunicación, liderazgo y de trabajo en equipo
• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo. Capacidad de aprendizaje. Autonomía.
• Acostumbrado a tener interlocución con el cliente, identificando sus problemas y como aportar valor de forma continua.
• Síntesis y claridad en la información técnica interpretando su impacto en negocio.
• Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de venta. Competencias deseables:
• Experiencia: Java SE 8 o superiores, Java EE6 o superiores, Spring Boot.
• Experiencia en DevOps y despliegue de infraestructura (AWS, Azure, GCP)
• Conocimientos: Python, javascript.
• Conocimientos y/o experiencia en herramientas de Monitorización APM (New relic, Dynatrace, ELK, Datadog, prometheus).
• Conocimientos de optimización del software.
• Experiencia en gestión y resolución de problemas.
• Capacidad de abstracción de problemas técnicos/negocio.
• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo. Capacidad de aprendizaje. Autonomía.
• Nivel medio inglés, B2

Se ofrece
• Salario competitivo en función de tus conocimientos y desempeño.
• Contrato estable.
• Jornada laboral flexible. Te ofrecemos una modalidad de trabajo flexible y adaptado a tu día a día, presencial, remoto o mixto.
• Formación personalizada a cargo de la empresa y de acuerdo a tus necesidades.
• Te proporcionamos el equipo de trabajo que tu elijas.
• Jornada reducida en verano
• Formar parte de una compañía consolidada y en crecimiento, con una cultura de trabajo positiva y colaborativa y donde las personas que la integran son su mayor activo

jobs_results.title: Senior Support & Software Engineer, Saudi Arabia
jobs_results.description:
• Note* - This role is office-based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Candidates must be based there or have the ability to relocate (we offer VISA sponsorship).

Combine your Linux support and software engineering skills, passion for technology, and your general knowledge of the full stack, from hardware to application, networking, Linux and open source, to help customers get the most from their solution from Canonical. Our team provides exceptional technical support and engineering solutions to help customers with everything open source from Ubuntu Server and Desktop to OpenStack and Kubernetes.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an open source technologist who enjoys solving problems under pressure.

What your day will look like
• Apply your knowledge of Linux virtualisation using Libvirt/KVM, containers and Kubernetes along with your knowledge of TCP/IP networking to support customised solutions for our customers.
• Be the technical authority and demonstrate your experience with... popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, Corosync/Pacemaker, MongoDB, MySQL and Apache.
• Provide advice on deployed architecture, implementing solutions for complex problems and guiding customers to successful data-center infrastructure operations
• Communicate regularly with the customer team about ongoing issues

What we are looking for in you
• BA/BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field
• Open source development or scripting experience
• Professional experience with OpenStack is a must
• Professional experience with Kubernetes and/or Ceph
• Must be able to speak English fluently
• Excellent communication skills and extensive experience in customer-facing positions
• High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
• Experience with or willingness to learn new technologies, including LXD, Snaps, MAAS, Juju and Ubuntu
• Ability to travel

If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, technical support, cloud-native development, data-center technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes and networking, you will love the Senior Support & Software Engineer role at Canonical.

What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner
• Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
• Annual compensation review
• Recognition rewards
• Annual holiday leave
• Parental Leave
• Employee Assistance Programme

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer, React Native
jobs_results.description:
Your mission

What will your contribution in this role be?

As a Senior React Native Engineer, your contribution in this role will be focused on writing portable and reusable code using React Native, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and CSS. You will collaborate closely with the Engineering Manager and UX/UI Designers to transform UI and functional specifications into visually appealing, smooth, performant, and near pixel-perfect interactive interfaces. Furthermore, as a Senior member of the frontend team, you will serve as a valuable source of knowledge and guidance, providing support and mentorship to other members of the team.

Key Accountabilities
• Design and develop new functionalities for the digital wallet platform, while optimizing existing features for better user experience.
• Serve as an expert in React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, and CSS, ensuring best practices and cutting-edge solutions are utilized.
• Actively participate in the software design process, contributing... technical insights and innovative ideas.
• Collaborate seamlessly with cross-functional teams, including designers, testers, and product managers, to ensure efficient project execution in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
• Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in React Native and related technologies to drive continuous innovation.
• Ensure code quality, maintainability, and performance by adhering to coding standards and conducting regular code reviews.
• Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve software issues, providing timely and robust solutions.
• Contribute to documentation for codebase maintenance, user manuals, and developer guidelines.
• Engage in team discussions, providing feedback and suggestions to improve application reliability, performance, and usability.
• Participate in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes, ensuring smooth deployment of updates and new features.

Your profile

Experience
• 4+ years of frontend development expertise, specializing in crafting top-notch user interfaces with React Native and React.js.
• Proficiency in UI development for both Android and iOS platforms.
• Skilled in integrating with REST APIs and Web Services for real-time app functionalities.
• Familiarity with fintech solutions, payment systems, and the implementation of Two-Factor Authentication is an added advantage.

Hard Skills
• React Native, React.js, JavaScript/Typescript, Node.js.
• CSS (including Bootstrap, SCSS, and other structured UI libraries).
• Capability to write secure code that works quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
• Full grasp of Git.
• Basic understanding of blockchain technology, including the Ethereum blockchain and smart contracts.

Soft Skills
• Problem solving
• Team collaboration
• Effective communication
• Attention to detail
• Planning and organizing skills
• User centric mindset
• Critical thinking

What we offer?

Join The Team And Let's Thrive Together
• Healthy working environment: Experience a supportive atmosphere where team members collaborate and inspire each other. Our positive work environment is designed to help you thrive both technically and personally.
• Autonomy, responsibilities, and opportunities: At Gamium, we believe in empowering our employees. You'll have the freedom to take ownership of your projects, contribute your unique ideas, and grow your skill set. We value your expertise and offer ample opportunities for professional development.
• Co-working in sunny Barcelona: Imagine working in one of the most vibrant cities in Europe! Our headquarters are located in beautiful Barcelona, where you'll enjoy a fantastic work-life balance and plenty of leisure activities outside of work.
• Hybrid model: Balancing work-life needs, our hybrid approach requires four days in the office weekly, with the flexibility to work remotely for one day.
• Healthcare allowance: We care about your well-being. To ensure you have access to the necessary healthcare services, we provide a comprehensive healthcare allowance to support your medical needs.
• Generous leave policy: We believe in the importance of rest and rejuvenation. You'll enjoy 25 vacation days annually, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. Take the time you need to recharge and return to work with renewed energy.

About Us

Gamium is a technology company that creates advanced digital identity and metaverse solutions for individuals, businesses, and developers.

We offer two products: Didit and Genesis.

DIDIT: Didit provides cutting-edge digital identity solutions for individuals and businesses, empowering them with greater convenience, security, and privacy on the internet.
• DIDIT BUSINESS: Didit’s Business solutions help companies enhance their entire customer journey, from registration to checkout, with advanced ID tools for user onboarding, identity verification, data authentication, and payments. They can be integrated as an all-in-one digital identity solution or by modules (Didit Verification, Didit Unified Access, Didit Data Transfer, and Didit Payments).
• DIDIT PERSONALDidit provides you with a free-to-use Digital Identity App that allows you to own and manage your Decentralized Identity with total convenience, security, and privacy.

GENESIS: Genesis is a social platform that allows users to create and live immersive virtual experiences with limitless possibilities.

With Genesis, individuals can venture into a vibrant world formed by 10 Neighborhoods and over 65,000 LANDs where their wildest dreams come to life.

SOCIALS
• Website: https://www.gamium.world
• Twitter: https://twitter.com/gamiumcorp
• Telegram: https://t.me/gamiumcorp

jobs_results.title: Senior Decarbonization Software Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
Pioneer the Future: Join Us in Accelerating Global Decarbonization with Siemens

Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Decarbonization Software Engineer (f/m/d) within our dynamic business incubation unit, where we accelerate transition of our customers to a low-carbon future through innovative software solutions. At Siemens, we are committed to revolutionizing the way towards decarbonization in an internal start-up approach to working.

Our commitment to scalable, outstanding, B2B projects reflects a forward-thinking approach, offering not only a great perspective but also the chance to shape the future of decarbonization at scale.

Immerse yourself in a multicultural and respectful working environment, collaborating within an agile, multi-functional team that embraces modern best practices in software engineering. Join us in making a lasting impact on the world's decarbonization efforts!

What are my responsibilities?
• As a Senior Decarbonization Software Engineer, you... will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining our data-intensive applications with a focus on ensuring the highest quality for new developments.
• Advocating and fostering a DevOps culture while contributing to the definition and implementation of CI/CD application pipelines.

• Deep motivation on decarbonization, with specific expertise in the energy sector being an advantage.

jobs_results.title: SDK AOSP Senior Software Engineer (Remoto)
jobs_results.description:
Estamos buscando un Desasrrollador Senior para trabajar en el desarrollo del sistema operativo en uno de nuestros proyectos.

Funciones y Responsabilidades

Las funciones de un Técnico Senior SDK AOSP para el desarrollo de un sistema operativo de televisión son:

Definición de requisitos del SDK: colaborar con los equipos de ingeniería y diseño para identificar y definir los requisitos del SDK necesario para el desarrollo de aplicaciones en el sistema operativo de televisión

Diseño del SDK: desarrollar una arquitectura de SDK que facilite el desarrollo de aplicaciones para televisión, incluyendo APIs, herramientas de desarrollo y documentación necesaria para los desarrolladores.

Desarrollo del SDK: implementar el SDK, escribir código y crear bibliotecas y herramientas que permitan a los desarrolladores crear aplicaciones compatibles con el sistema operativo de televisión.

Pruebas del SDK: realizar pruebas exhaustivas del SDK para garantizar su funcionamiento correcto y su... compatibilidad con una amplia gama de dispositivos y escenarios de uso.

Documentación del SDK: crear documentación detallada y ejemplos de código para guiar a los desarrolladores en el uso del SDK y en el desarrollo de aplicaciones para televisión.

Soporte técnico: brindar soporte técnico a los desarrolladores que utilizan el SDK, resolver problemas técnicos y proporcionar orientación sobre mejores prácticas de desarrollo.

Colaboración interdepartamental: trabajar en estrecha colaboración con otros equipos, como ingeniería de hardware, diseño de experiencia de usuario y control de calidad, para garantizar la integración coherente del SDK en el sistema operativo de televisión.

Actualización del SDK: mantener el SDK actualizado con las últimas versiones del sistema operativo, corregir errores y agregar nuevas características según sea necesario para mejorar la experiencia de desarrollo de aplicaciones para televisión.

Investigación y desarrollo: investigar nuevas tecnologías y tendencias en el desarrollo de aplicaciones para televisión, y colaborar en el desarrollo de prototipos y conceptos innovadores para futuras versiones del SDK y del sistema operativo de televisión, emergentes como serverless, edge computing o desarrollos en Inteligencia Artificial en la nube.

La persona que buscamos debe cumplir con los siguientes requisitos:

Título y Educación

Título en Ingeniería de Software, Ciencias de la Computación o campo relacionado.

Educación avanzada en sistemas operativos, desarrollo de software embebido y tecnologías Android.

Experiencia Laboral

Experiencia previa en desarrollo de sistemas operativos embebidos, preferiblemente en el ámbito de la televisión.

Historial de trabajo con Android y AOSP, incluyendo experiencia en la creación y utilización de SDKs (Software Development Kits).

Conocimientos técnicos

Amplio dominio de los principios de diseño de sistemas operativos y la arquitectura de Android

Experiencia en la creación de SDKs personalizados para permitir el desarrollo de aplicaciones específicas para televisión

Competencia en el desarrollo de API y frameworks para facilitar la integración de aplicaciones de terceros

Experiencia con CI/CD y utilización de herramientas y prácticas de Integración Continua y Despliegue Continuo (CI/CD) para agilizar el lanzamiento de aplicaciones y servicios.

Habilidades interpersonales

Capacidad para comunicar de manera efectiva con equipos de desarrollo, diseñadores de experiencia de usuario y otros stakeholders.

Habilidad para liderar iniciativas y coordinar esfuerzos entre equipos multifuncionales.

Otras competencias

Orientación hacia la innovación y la mejora continua de los procesos de desarrollo de software

Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno dinámico y adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios tecnológicos y de mercado.

Fuertes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para enfrentar desafíos técnicos complejos de manera efectiva

jobs_results.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs_results.description:
El puesto de Senior Fullstack Developer (Desarrollador Fullstack) es un rol especializado en el campo del desarrollo de software. Este puesto se enfoca en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web que involucran tanto el lado del servidor como el lado del cliente.

Funciones:
• Desarrollo de Software tanto en Backend como en Frontend.

Requisitos:

Titulación:
• Titulación Superior en Informática o Grado Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web o Aplicaciones Multiplataforma.

Conocimientos:
• API REST.
• Docker.
• Plataforma Cloud: Azure, AWS o GCP.
• Pruebas unitarias.

Experiencia:
• Experiencia mínima profesional de 5 años.
• Desarrollo con framework Microsoft .NET 6, ASP.NET Core 3.1 o superior.
• Angular v14.
• Desarrollo JavaScript ES6+, HTML 5 y CSS 3.
• Patrones de diseño: DDD, Clean Architecture, CQRS.
• Lenguaje SQL y diseño de base de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL).

Valorable:
• UI/UX.
• Uso de herramientas de testing: Postman o Selenium.
• Conocimientos de CI ... CD.
• Conocimientos de Kubernetes.
• Conocimientos de Arquitectura de microservicios.
• Conocimientos de Python.
• Trabajo en equipo en marcos de trabajo Agile y uso de herramientas de gestión

#PassionForTalent

En OGA te ofrecemos un entorno de trabajo en Sevilla junto a un equipo apasionado por los datos, con proyectos muy exigentes y retadores tecnológicamente para empresas líderes internacionales en sus diferentes sectores, en el que disfrutarás de variados beneficios sociales y de un entorno de conciliación certificado como empresa familiarmente responsable -efr- por la Fundación Másfamilia.

Si tus capacidades encajan con nuestra actividad y te apetece formar parte de un equipo que está desarrollando soluciones transformadoras, te invitamos a aplicar por esta posición

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer (Senior / Staff / Principal)
jobs_results.description:
🐼 Who we are

Never Alone with Alan. The health partner, who prevents, insures, and cares daily.

Our mission is a healthier humanity. For our members, getting extra happy years of life. For our companies: the best people return on investment.

We partner with 22,000 companies, more than 500,000 members and are at €350m+ ARR. We now operate in France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸 and Belgium 🇧🇪.

The team is 580 people, and growing all over Europe.

🤘 How we do it

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

- Members first. We put our members first, our team second, our shareholders third.

- Radical Transparency. We make all choices in writing and adopt a direct and honest style of communication.

- Personal & Team Growth. We are self-improving whilst helping others grow. We’re no ego-doers and we all edit the company.

- Distributed Ownership. We trust our colleagues to... make the right choices. We are not afraid to fail fast individually to learn collectively in the long run.

- Fearless ambition. We shoot for the moon and work backwards. We focus on solving complex problems with simple principles far from ready made ideas.

⭐️ The Engineering team ⭐️

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React/Redux, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more?

Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan looks like, and how our Engineering team is organised: https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan

⭐️ Is it you we’re looking for? ⭐️

We are looking for engineers with 5+ years of experience to help us scale our Engineering community from different perspectives (product, tech, and internal organization-wise):

- You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.

- You'll design efficient systems and engineering practices to align with and facilitate interactions between multiple teams/products.

- You’ll have the opportunity to mentor other engineers & lead crews (more details in this article).

- You'll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates' hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

- Well-versed in Object Oriented Programming such as Python, Java, C#, and enthusiastic about web technologies such as modern Javascript.

- Willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don't need to have experience with those 2 languages!).

- Passionate about building products.

- Self-starting and entrepreneurial.

- Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).

- Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.

- Fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity! Everything else is a bonus.

For more details on how engineers can grow at Alan, take a look at our Engineering career path: https://medium.com/alan/engineering-career-path-at-alan-e5de5c2e740c

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

- Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

- Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

- All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

- Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

- Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family.

- Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

- Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

- Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success

Company Description

Mirantis is the fastest way to modern apps, providing containers-as-a-service at enterprise scale. The company uses a unique as-a-service model to deliver Kubernetes and related open-source software, empowering developers to build, share and run their applications anywhere - from public cloud to hybrid cloud to the edge. Mirantis serves many of the world’s leading enterprises, including Adobe, DocuSign, Liberty Mutual, PayPal, Reliance Jio, Splunk, STC, Vodafone, and Volkswagen. Learn more at www.mirantis.com.

Job Description

Mirantis is looking for an experienced Java Software Engineer to participate in developing networking software - an open-source SDN controller based on OpenFlow, capable of managing traffic on tens of thousands of switches simultaneously, controlling millions of flows, and providing sub-second network telemetry.

The Service You’ll Be Working On Is In Production And Is Growing Rapidly. The Service Is a Next-generation Cloud-native... Networking Service Used As a Backbone For Telecommunication Networks. Some Of The Technologies Are
• OpenFlow Controller - Floodlight and OpenvSwitch
• Apache Storm
• Apache Kafka
• Apache Zookeper
• Neo4j
• Docker
• Linux networking (network namespaces, TUN/TAP interfaces, OVS, routing and switching)
• Github
• Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery

Responsibilities
• Contribute to design and development
• Design and develop scalable SDN solution with zero downtime
• Work closely with customers and contractors in a collaborative development environment
• Follow the development practices - TDD, Code Reviews, CI/CD, automated tests, etc.
• Troubleshoot problems as needed in the QA and production environments.
• Occasionally travel to customer sites

Qualifications
• 5+ years of progressive experience in Java development and testing
• Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for the full software development life cycle.
• Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
• Background in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and distributed programming
• Upper-Intermediate written and spoken English
• Basic knowledge in Networking technologies (L2/L3 switching, VLANs, SDN)
• Design Patterns (GOF, EAA)
• EU location and work permit
• Desired
• Experience influencing software engineers with best practices
• Familiar with ELK stack and Grafana
• Knowledge in Networking technologies (L2/L3 switching, VLANs, SDN). Understanding how the network works at a low level and all levels 2,3 and 4 of the networking stack.
• Experience with issue-tracking systems: Jira, etc.
• Experience with Python
• Experience with UML

Additional Information

What does Mirantis offer you?
• Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry.
• Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.
• Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
• Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
• Career and professional growth.
• Benefit program.
